=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:504-521 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: model_reasoning_effort is only written into config.toml and is not passed as a -c CLI override, so a config-write failure can leave the verifier running with the model's default reasoning effort.
  WHY: The reviewers agree the command lacks a belt-and-suspenders fallback; one reviewer disputed that this is a correctness bug and treated it as a hardening-only concern, but the shared issue is the missing CLI fallback.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:536-537 | severity=low
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: prepare_llm_codex_home can leak the temporary CODEX_HOME directory when it exits via BaseException subclasses that bypass the inner cleanup path.
  WHY: The internal except Exception block will not catch KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit, and codex_home remains None so the outer cleanup does not remove the mkdtemp directory.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  PROBLEM: The LLM verifier relies exclusively on prepare_llm_codex_home() writing model_reasoning_effort into config.toml to set the reasoning level for the codex CLI invocation.
  WHY: The cmd array has -c model_verbosity=low and -c include_apply_patch_tool=true but no -c model_reasoning_effort=low (or equivalent), so if config writes silently fail the codex call proceeds without the intended reasoning effort.
